frozen_journeys.description: One local guest selects Cleveland, September 5, 2026 at 2:00 PM for four players, one bay, and 120 minutes, reviews the server-owned $88.00 USD sandbox total, and sees confirmation persist after refresh.
A declined or retryable sandbox attempt creates no reservation. A later approved scenario can create exactly one owner-bound local reservation.

payment_contract.amount_source: Server-side integer minor units from the persisted bay-session price. Party size remains one to six players in one bay and does not multiply the per-bay price. The client cannot submit amount, tax, fee, currency, owner, or fingerprint.
payment_contract.owner: Site-local account subject or anonymous browser session digest resolved from the opaque host-only session cookie.
payment_contract.fingerprint: SHA-256 over canonical JSON containing slot id, party size, one bay, and the server-resolved owner key.
payment_contract.final_commit: consume_approval(), final availability recheck, bay increment, and reservation insertion run on one SiteBackend SQLite connection and transaction. Failure leaves no reservation and does not reserve a bay.

proof_obligations: Only opaque configured sandbox scenario ids are accepted. Payment credentials and client-supplied payment facts are rejected.
Amount is 8800 integer USD minor units derived from the persisted selected session.
Duplicate approved submissions converge to one reservation and one consumed approval.
Declined and retryable attempts create no reservation.
A stale slot fingerprint or foreign owner cannot consume approval or read a reservation.
Approval consumption, availability recheck, bay increment, and reservation insertion roll back together after final-state failure.
Reset clears local payment and reservation rows while restart retains site binding.
The only adapter is local-sandbox. Stripe test, live payment, SMS, email, and production requests remain unavailable.
Cross-site databases, identities, sessions, payment flows, attempts, and reservations cannot be shared or replayed.
